description: Scripts for the repeatable steps of Schola work. Each entry names its safety class. An agent never runs a human-only entry.

safety_classes.read-only: Reads files, git, or the network. Changes nothing.
safety_classes.local-write: Changes files in the working tree, a clone tree, or the temporary folder.
safety_classes.remote-write: Pushes, comments, labels, or opens a pull request.
safety_classes.human-only: Publish, deploy, spend, login, or secrets. An agent never runs it.

mcp_exposure.expose: The MCP server lists the tool.
mcp_exposure.hidden: The MCP server never lists the tool. This is the default when the field is missing, so a new tool stays out of the server until someone marks it. A human-only tool must be hidden.

exit_codes.2: wrong use of the script, a refused lock file, or another gate running
exit_codes.130: interrupted; the child process was stopped

tools.name: gate_matrix
tools.description: Run the Python unit and server suites on each supported Python version, one gate at a time, and print one line per suite. A suite that runs no tests, or skips every test, fails.
writes: a new schola-gate-* folder in the temporary folder (logs)
a lock file in the temporary folder (a kernel lock; the file stays and holds the last owner's pid)

arguments.name: --timeout
arguments.description: Seconds one suite may run before it is killed.

arguments.name: --python
arguments.description: VERSION=PATH. Use this interpreter for a version. Repeat for more.

arguments.name: --allow-missing
arguments.description: Skip a version with no interpreter instead of failing.

arguments.name: --list
arguments.description: Print the plan and run nothing.

arguments.name: --lock-dir
arguments.description: The folder that holds the one-gate-at-a-time lock file.

output.format: text, or one JSON object with --json

shape.log_dir: string, the folder with one log file per suite
shape.results: array of {version, suite, status (pass|fail|timeout|missing|wrong_version|skip), tests, skipped, seconds, first_failure, log, python}

tools.name: smoke
tools.description: Run the command line and the local server on a new data folder and compare each answer with what it must be, including the refusal of the hub route without a token.
writes: a new schola-smoke-* data folder in the temporary folder, removed at the end
a server on a free loopback port, stopped at the end

arguments.name: --seed
arguments.description: A folder to copy into the new data folder first.

arguments.name: --wait
arguments.description: Seconds to wait for the server to say it is ready.

output.format: text, or one JSON object with --json

tools.name: pr_body.scaffold
tools.description: Print a pull request body with the changed files and the gate result filled in. The agent replaces each TODO line.

arguments.name: --base
arguments.description: The base branch to compare with.

arguments.name: --gate-json
arguments.description: A file with the output of gate_matrix.py --json.

shape.body: headings What changed, How it was verified, Limits; the attribution line last

tools.name: pr_body.check
tools.description: Check a pull request body against the rules that need no judgment: 300 words, required headings, no bare numbers, no tables, no dash characters, no session links, no TODO placeholder, known callouts, the attribution line last.

arguments.name: file
arguments.description: The body file, or - for standard input.

output.format: text (problem lines, then OK or FAIL), or one JSON object with --json
